component.name: KeySender
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub
sub run() port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("key", port) clock = CreateObject("roTimespan") pending = [] busy = invalid busySince = 0 while true msg = wait(250, port) now = clock.TotalMilliseconds() if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" then pending.Push({key: msg.getData(), at: now}) else if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" then busy = invalid end if if busy <> invalid and now - busySince > 1500 then busy.AsyncCancel() busy = invalid end if while pending.Count() > 0 and now - pending[0].at > 1500 pending.Shift() end while if busy = invalid and pending.Count() > 0 then busy = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") busy.SetMessagePort(port) busy.SetUrl(m.top.server + "/api/key?name=" + pending.Shift().key) busySince = now if not busy.AsyncGetToString() then busy = invalid end if end while end sub
